The $50B Rural Health Transformation Program under H.R.1 is a necessary correction to decades of systemic neglect - but only if states enforce strict accountability. While expanding rural care access is critical (25% of rural hospitals faced closure risks under Biden’s Medicaid cuts), the real test is whether funds actually reach frontline providers instead of bureaucratic middlemen.

Ohio’s $202M first-year allocation must bypass administrative bloat and directly upgrade facilities, retain staff, and adopt AI-driven diagnostics. H.R.1 Section 71401 mandates states submit transformation plans with measurable outcomes, which is non-negotiable.

Every dollar should combat the 30% rural health cost inflation caused by Biden-era supply chain failures and pharma price gouging. This isn’t a blank check—it’s a strategic investment in medical sovereignty. Now watchdog the spending like hawks.
